title: introduce-credential-thermostat-and-compact-stream-iterator-ergonomics
author: Sofia Martinez
release_notes: Python 2.3.0, TypeScript 1.12.0, Go v0.8.2: introduce credential thermostat backoff, ergonomic streaming iterator polish, cross-SDK parity for stream resume semantics.
description: Motivation: We have recurring friction and edge-case failures around credential refresh windows combined with bursty streaming workloads. This PR introduces a small runtime-side 'credential thermostat' that smooths reauth attempts across SDKs, plus an ergonomic compact streaming iterator abstraction to make retry/resume behavior consistent across Python/TS/Go. These changes aim to reduce token churn, avoid simultaneous reauth storms during capacity pressure, and make SDK consumer code simpler for common streaming patterns. Summary of changes: - Introduce a lightweight credential thermostat (in-memory, process-local) that staggers refresh attempts using a jittered cooldown window and a priority hint from the connector. Implemented in SDK core and wired into all three language adapters. - Add CompactStreamIterator abstraction (Python: CompactAsyncIterator, TS: CompactAsyncIterable, Go: CompactStreamReader) that exposes a single resume() method, backpressure-safe chunk iteration, and a small state machine to cleanly reconcile reauth & transient reconnects. - Harmonize auth retry profiles: new defaults reduce aggressive immediate retries and favor exponential backoff with capped jitter. - Update examples and docs and bump package versions. - Add unit and integration tests that simulate credential rotation and mid-stream reauth scenarios. Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed by SRE and Runtime teams - [x] API ergonomics reviewed by SDK leads - [x] Unit tests for python/typescript/go - [x] Integration test against local canary runtime - [x] Changelog and version bumps included Commits (high level):  - 0b1c3fa: introduce thermostat scheduler and tests  - 47a9b21: add CompactStreamIterator interface and TS implementation  - fad7e33: wire thermostat into python SDK session manager  - 9c2e4f0: implement Go CompactStreamReader + backoff adapter  - a7f5d12: update examples, changelog, and bump versions  - 12d3b88: fix flaky test by adjusting thermostat jitter seed Changed files (high level): ["sdk/python/redwood/session/thermostat.py", "sdk/python/redwood/stream/compact_iterator.py", "sdk/python/setup.py", "sdk/typescript/src/auth/thermostat.ts", "sdk/typescript/src/stream/compactIterable.ts", "sdk/typescript/package.json", "sdk/go/cred/thermostat.go", "sdk/go/stream/compact_reader.go", "examples/streaming/thermostat-demo.py", "docs/sdk/streaming.md", "docs/sdk/auth.md", "CHANGELOG.md", "integration-tests/streaming/thermostat_rotations.test"] Review conversation (condensed): - Priya: "Nice to see a controlled approach to reauth storms. Can we ensure thermostat state is process-local only and does not create cross-container coupling?" - Sofia: "Yes — thermostat is explicitly process-local and not persisted. We discussed a global leader election but rejected it due to complexity; added a comment in code and doc note." - Liam: "TS ergonomics look good, but rename resumeTo(token) -> resumeWith(cursor) for parity with Python; also update deprecation note." - Sofia: "Renamed in TS and added a small compatibility shim for old callers. Updated CHANGELOG." - Ethan: "Integration test failed once on CI (intermittent) — suspect RNG seeding for jitter." - Sofia: "Fixed by seeding jitter deterministically in tests and expanding timeouts for CI environment; re-ran suite." CI & validation: - Initial CI run failed due to an intermittent integration test (flaky jitter seed). - Updated tests to deterministically seed jitter in CI; all tests green on second run. - Lint/format checks required a minor rename and were auto-fixed by pre-commit hook. Backwards compatibility and ergonomics notes: - Public surface maintained: changes are additive and default retry profiles are conservative; consumers may opt back into previous aggressive retry strategy via new config flag (auth.retry.profile=legacy_immediate). - CompactStreamIterator intentionally keeps resume() signature consistent across languages; we added lightweight shims for older API shapes to ease migration. Version bumps: - python sdk -> 2.3.0 - typescript sdk -> 1.12.0 - go sdk -> v0.8.2 Observability and telemetry: - New metrics: sdk.auth.thermostat.cooldowns, sdk.stream.resume.count, sdk.stream.resume.latency. - Tracing: thermostat decisions annotated on session traces to help debug correlated reauth events. Follow-ups: - ENG-3860: consider a cluster-aware thermostat for Dedicated deployments (future work) - Add a canary against dedicated capacity to validate cross-container behavior (security reviewed) Merge notes: - Squash-merged after approvals from Priya and Liam. No database or customer-facing breaking changes. Rollout: - Enabled by default; SDK releases planned to coordinate with hosted runtime to avoid surprises.
